_comment: Wave 12 item 7, S1 run 3 + the record read-back wave 11 missed: the pod pilot (w12_scan_inside: Kit Lancer + one Kit Contraband Pod, ScanMask 0x0001) STARTS in Kit Scan Range beside Kit Scan Port (Enter Ship, no jump). Is it scanned without arriving by jump? Watch 60 s (a shot every ~2.5 s), then land at once (the port is under the player), read the map's Legal Status, leave and pull: the 2069 record after a fine (SmugPenalty 50?) and the credits.
